incidents.step: gh attestation verify (online form), first run, both files
incidents.discoveredBy: the assistant, by re-running the same command through a local deny-by-default logging proxy after noticing bundle_url (an Azure blob address with a signed query) in the stored attestations API response and an empty bundle_url in the CLI output
